vibe_rationale: Long-running grassroots skate contest backed by local businesses, a genuine scene but a single contest rather than a culture weekend.
fit_notes: Youth-heavy skate crowd, so the adult share is small and the fit with a health brand is weak. Local businesses already fund a prize pool above $10,000, so a division or prize sponsorship is a low-cost entry point; it is an NSW event, so direct activation is possible.
